verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships a CLI (Wally) that can run small local models offline, so this axis applies. However, no evidence documents command-line flags for GPU offload (layer count) or context length. The docs instead stress that there is "nothing to configure by hand," and the only documented flag, `--cloud`, selects hosted versus local execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
